companyDescription: AI Memory · HBM3E/HBM4 sold out through 2026 — picks & shovels of the AI era via high-bandwidth memory for GPU clusters
priceNote: Down 10% on broad semiconductor sell-off — pre-earnings dip ahead of Q3 FY26 results tomorrow Jun 24
summary: Micron reports Q3 FY26 earnings tomorrow Jun 24 with consensus expecting $34.66B revenue and 81.6% gross margin — both potential all-time highs. HBM capacity is sold out through 2026 and HBM4 production ramp is 2x the speed of HBM3. Today's 10% pullback on sector-wide macro sell-off creates a pre-earnings entry window. Bull case analyst targets reach $1,750 (+60%). Extreme binary risk: beat-and-raise = big pop, miss = sharp drop.

catalysts.name: Q3 FY26 Earnings — Tomorrow
catalysts.description: Jun 24, 2026 — Consensus $34.66B revenue (top of guided range $32.75–$34.25B), EPS $19.95, gross margin 81.6% (potential all-time record). HBM4 ramp commentary will be the key forward catalyst.

catalysts.name: HBM4 Ramp — 2x Speed of HBM3
catalysts.description: Micron's HBM4 production ramp is proceeding at twice the rate of HBM3. Allocations for Nvidia Vera Rubin Ultra (2027) are the key forward metric — commentary on Jun 24 call is critical.

catalysts.name: HBM Sold Out Through 2026
catalysts.description: Micron's HBM3E capacity is fully allocated through end of 2026, driven by AI server demand from Nvidia, AMD, and hyperscalers. Structural supply constraint supports premium pricing and margin expansion.

risks: Earnings binary risk — any miss vs $34.66B consensus or weak Q4 guidance triggers sharp drop (stock already down 10% into print)
DRAM oversupply risk — commodity DRAM cycles faster than HBM; non-AI memory could weigh on blended margins
Samsung HBM3E qualification at Nvidia — potential share erosion if Samsung catches up on quality
Macro sell-off extends — broader tech risk-off could pressure even a beat-and-raise scenario

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Rate cuts expected H2 2026 — positive for capital-intensive memory capex cycle and semiconductor multiples
macroRisk.inflationNote: HBM memory spot prices surging (HBM + GDDR6 up ~3x) due to structural supply shortage — actually inflationary for Micron margins
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Semiconductor memory sector hit hardest by macro risk-off today (-10%+ sell-off). But AI-driven structural demand for HBM insulates Micron vs commodity DRAM players.
macroRisk.summary: Fed risk MEDIUM — rate cuts support capex multiples but today's broad sell-off shows macro volatility is real. HBM scarcity is a structural, not cyclical, tailwind. Pre-earnings dip may be a buying opportunity if thesis intact.
